text: This public landing extracts InitTokenizer, clears tokenizer aliases after replacing a line, and calls the helper before a parenthesized-group scan resumes after a literal. CreateLiteral can advance to the next line when it consumes the entire current line. The added fake-server test expects a parsed ID value and another completed inbox update, but it was not run. Later accepted bounds/precondition checks are separate. Both required discussions are restricted, so this source-supported finding has zero full-audit credit and makes no broader parser-safety or protocol-compliance claim.
title: The parenthesized IMAP parser reacquires tokenizer storage after a literal advances the line
